title: Mad Beach Boat Rentals
specs: Fleet boats are no older than three years
Must be at least 18 years old with valid ID to sign contracts
Boat license required if born after January 1, 1988; Florida or NASBLA boater’s education card required
Jet ski operators must be at least 16 years old with parent present to sign if minor
Valid driver’s license and major credit card for refundable $500 deposit required
Reservations recommended at least 3 days in advance for weekends and holidays

options.name: Boat Rental
options.detail: Rent pontoon or deck boats for exploring local waters

variants.label: Rent pontoon or deck boats for exploring local waters

includes: Fuel included for jet skis; not included for boats
gap: Duration of each boat rental not stated
blurb: Guests rent boats or jet skis to explore local waters including Shell Key, John’s Pass Sandbars, and Bunce’s Pass Sandbar. Operators must meet age and licensing requirements. Rentals include liability insurance but guests are responsible for damages.
extraNote: $500 deposit per vessel required, refundable after return check-in · 24-hour cancellation notice required to avoid $100 fee; no-shows charged full rate · No cancellation fee for bad weather conditions; option to reschedule or cancel · All vessels board, depart, return and disembark from docks at 8612 Bay Pines Blvd, St. Petersburg, FL 33709 unless using Dockside Delivery & Pick Up.
